order_purchase_date: The date when the order was placed.
received_date: The date when the order was received.
sales_demand: Forecasted or historical demand for the product.
sales_volume: Total volume of sales for the product.
seasonality: Indicates the seasonal nature of the product demand.
storage_recommendation: Instructions for proper storage of the product.
unit_of_measurement: Standard unit used for quantity tracking (e.g., kg, liters, units).
shelf_life_days: Total shelf life of the product in days.
maximum_days_on_sale: Maximum duration the product can remain on sale before expiration/devaluation.
supplier_rating: Performance or quality rating of the supplier.
distance_km: Distance between the supplier and the warehouse in kilometers.
moq: Minimum Order Quantity required by the supplier.
delivery_days: Number of days required for delivery after order placement.
in_season: Boolean indicator (True/False) if the product is currently in its natural season.
is_holiday: Boolean indicator (True/False) if the date is a holiday.
day_classification: Classification of the day (e.g., weekday, weekend, public holiday).
is_weekend: Boolean indicator (True/False) if the day is a weekend.
min_stock: Minimum stock level threshold for replenishment.
stock_quantity: Current quantity of the product in stock.
temperature_classification: Weather-related temperature classification (e.g., hot, cold, moderate).
wind_classification: Weather-related wind classification (e.g., breezy, windy, calm).
weather_severity: Overall severity level of the weather conditions.
